DDInter1673.mechanism: Coadministration with milk thistle may increase the plasma concentrations of simeprevir. The proposed mechanism is inhibition of CYP450 3A4-mediated metabolism by milk thistle.

DDInter489.mechanism: Coadministration of deferiprone with uridine diphosphate glucuronosyltransferase (UGT) 1A6 inhibitors may increase the plasma concentrations of deferiprone, which is metabolized by the enzyme.
